claims.text: Multiple baselines were tested, including a human performance baseline and a No-answer baseline.
The study describes three baselines on the answerability task that improve performance over a majority-class baseline.
BERT-based baselines were implemented for evidence identification.
The No-answer baseline provides a lower bound on performance at this task.
